ITEM 1 | Five-ish small cylindrical pieces, golden-orange to reddish-brown with a slightly bumpy, matte, dry surface and some browned edges; roughly 2 cm wide and 4-5 cm long, arranged in a loose cluster on the left of the plate, with a few small pale seeds visible on one piece | 85
ITEM 2 | Bright green floret clusters with dark green stems, some slightly charred tips, moist-looking, firm; two separate clumps, each about 3-4 cm across, sitting between the cylindrical pieces and the slice | 40
ITEM 3 | Rectangular slice about 10 cm by 9 cm with a thick, pale cream-to-golden layer of melted cheese, browned in spots, with red-orange tomato sauce visible in streaks across the top; the crust edge is pale tan, soft-looking, and a bit thick at the right side | 210
ITEM 4 | Thin red-orange tomato sauce layer spread over the top of the slice, glossy and slightly wet where it shows between cheese patches | 15
